items.h: India's industrial output growth slows to 6.7% in September as manufacturing, consumer durables lose momentum

items.p: Bajaj Finance and Tata Capital are testing alternative loan structures to protect MSME and small-business lending as the central bank signals little willingness to relax its proposed restrictions.

items.h: India plans  ₹8,000-cr outlay to boost khadi, handloom and handicraft output
items.p: The latest push assumes importance because new trade deals have opened doors abroad, but exports of handloom and handicrafts may not take off in a big way unless Indian businesses improve competitiveness, build scale and connect better to overseas markets

items.h: Oil slips after early surge as US-Iran tensions persist, Brent falls 3%
items.p: The volatility poses a concern for India as it imports about 90% of its overall crude oil requirements. The import bill in the last fiscal year stood at around $123 billion.

items.h: SBI eyes margin boost from rate hikes, but wary of consumption credit hit
items.p: Speaking at the State Bank of India’s September quarter earnings press conference, chairman Setty said government bond yields were already factoring in one more rate hike, suggesting that much of the likely rate movement was already priced in

items.h: Who is Rajendra Lodha? Former Lodha Developers director faces fresh FIR over alleged  ₹6.67 crore Mumbai flat fraud
items.p: The latest complaint, filed by Lodha Developers, accuses Lodha and five others of manipulating a property transaction dating back to 2019 and causing substantial financial losses to the company.

items.h: Mint Explainer | Why are premium European automakers betting on India?
items.p: European premium automakers have joined established players such as Mercedes-Benz, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover to expand in India. Why has India become important to these brands?

items.h: Farah Khan's bedroom makeover: From damp walls and dated interiors to a glamorous retreat with a walk-in closet, vanity
items.p: Farah Khan has given her bedroom a complete makeover after being nominated by Karan Johar. From damp walls and dated flooring to a stylish vanity, designer wardrobe and statement lighting, the filmmaker's room now resembles a luxury hotel suite.

items.h: Explainer: New building block: how project-wise insolvency will shield homebuyers
items.p: To shield buyers in financially sound projects from a developer’s default elsewhere, the insolvency watchdog IBBI has notified new regulations enabling the Committee of Creditors to recommend exclusion of healthy projects, even when the developer as a whole enters the insolvency

items.h: LIC Housing Finance recovers  ₹553 crore from retail portfolio in Q2, targets 14-15% growth in disbursements
items.p: LIC HFL is exploring lease rental discounting, loans against property and other non-housing segments to diversify its portfolio and improve yields.

items.h: India withdraws bid for top global telecom post, misses return after six decades
items.p: New Delhi pulls Revathi Mannepalli’s candidature for Radiocommunication Bureau director just days before the Doha election, surprising industry experts.

items.h: Pro-Kannada group visits Bengaluru IT companies amid renewed focus on alleged hiring discrimination against local youths
items.p: A pro-Kannada group is asking Bengaluru businesses to provide more employment opportunities to locals. Its campaign seeks information on recruitment practices, amid allegations of discrimination and a paused state proposal for private-sector job reservations.

items.h: Mumbai to Thane in 20 mins! Why Thane is new core of MMR with landmark infrastructure project Thane-Borivali Twin Tunnel
items.p: Thane is emerging as a key growth hub in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), with the 11.8-km Thane-Borivali Twin Tunnel set to cut travel time to 20 minutes. Metro lines and major road projects are further strengthening its connectivity.

items.h: Mouse movements & app switches: inside the software tracking IT employees’ activity
items.p: ProHance CEO Ankur Dhingra addresses growing privacy alarms among India’s IT workers and explains why his tracking platform is essential for enterprise decisions.

items.h: A sneak peek into Sourav Ganguly's luxurious lifestyle:  ₹40-crore Kolkata mansion with 48 rooms and a cricket pitch
items.p: Sourav Ganguly’s ancestral home in Behala reflects his family history and cricketing career. The more than 60-year-old mansion includes a Wall of Fame, a trophy room filled with memorabilia and a backyard cricket pitch.

items.h: Beyond cricket: can non-cricket sporting leagues add value to platforms' entertainment mix?
items.p: Non-cricket sports help streaming platforms sustain year-round viewing, attract niche audiences and reduce churn. Their value lies in complementing cricket and entertainment, provided platforms convert sports-driven attention into lasting engagement.

items.h: Creators take the party offline to build brands and unlock new revenue streams
items.p: As India's creator base grows, influencers are taking audiences offline through festivals, workshops and gatherings to build communities and diversify earnings. Festivals like Halloween and Diwali have added momentum, while brands gain new opportunities to engage audiences in per

items.h: Mannat's  ₹300-crore valuation, heritage status and renovation: How Shah Rukh Khan's dream home evolved
items.p: From its origins as a sea-facing Mumbai bungalow to its reported  ₹300-crore valuation and heritage status, Mannat has evolved into one of India's best-known celebrity homes. Its renovation has added another chapter to its story.

items.h: Investments in renewable energy helped India avert energy crisis amid West Asia war, says PM Modi
items.p: India has already met its Paris Agreement target of sourcing 50% of installed power capacity from non-fossil fuels, five years ahead of schedule. Modi said the country aims to add another 500 GW over the next 10-11 years.

items.h: Gadkari pushes alternative fuels to cut India's  ₹22 trillion fuel import bill
items.p: The government is promoting indigenous, cost-effective and less-polluting energy sources, including ethanol, compressed biogas, hydrogen and biofuels, to reduce import dependence.

items.h: Mumbai airport standoff: Airlines challenge Adani’s proposed 5 million passenger capacity cut
items.p: AOC-Mumbai has sought the aviation ministry's intervention over a proposed 5-million-passenger capacity cut and the relocation of international flights to Navi Mumbai, as foreign carriers resist the move.

items.h: Trai tightens telecom complaint rules, mandates 24-hour customer support
items.p: Telecom operators face penalties of up to  ₹20 lakh per quarter for improperly closed complaints and appeals, as Trai cuts grievance redressal timelines and tightens accountability.

items.h: Delhi pollution curbs: Construction activities to face restrictions from November 5; what you need to know
items.p: Delhi pollution curbs: Authorities would take prompt action against industries that fail to meet pollution standards, and against major sources of emissions and traffic congestion hotspots, with the help of the new monitoring system.

items.h: India’s apex drugs regulator turns the screws on pharmaceutical-grade raw materials linked to syrup contamination risks
items.p: The drug regulator has said no batch of key syrup ingredients can leave a factory without a digital clearance. Drug makers back the tighter tracking, but worry that portal glitches could hold up production and supplies.

items.h: The price of Gulf war is flashing on cement bags
items.p: Prices of coal and petcoke, both key to cement making, have stayed high as the war in West Asia drags on. Manufacturers like UltraTech, Ambuja Cements and Dalmia Bharat are left with no option to pass on the higher costs. The hikes came in September and October.

items.h: State-run bank chiefs see credit growth holding firm despite margin pressures
items.p: Rising funding costs and competition for deposits remain key challenges.

items.h: Emirates NBD charts next phase of India expansion after RBL deal
items.p: Emirates NBD is leveraging its acquisition of RBL Bank to tap into India's growing middle-class and affluent segments, scale digital banking synergies across the UAE-India corridor and expand its footprint through strategic bolt-on acquisitions and venture investments.

items.h: Why Indian cinema can’t match Hollywood’s 100-day advance booking model
items.p: Censor delays, unconfirmed runtimes, and last-minute date shifts keep Indian cinema tied to short booking windows. Experts suggest a phased premium strategy could help event films bridge the gap.

items.h: CDSCO cancels import licence of Korean cosmetic FatX over misleading 'fat-dissolving' claim
items.p: The drug regulator ruled that fat-dissolving claims fall strictly under drug laws rather than cosmetics rules, revoking the importer’s permit after rejecting its plea for voluntary surrender.

items.h: Pune Metro Line 3: Route, station list, timings and connectivity - all you need to know
items.p: Pune Metro Line 3, connecting Maan and Hinjewadi IT Park with Shivajinagar, will be inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi on November 3. Services on the 23.2-km corridor will begin at 6 am on November 4, with 17 of its 23 stations opening initially.

items.h: Flying from Mumbai on Nov 19? Here's what you should know about 6-hour airport closure
items.p: Both runways at the airport — RWY 09/27 and RWY 14/32 — will remain closed between 11 am and 5 pm on November 19, MIAL said

items.h: NBCC’s Avenue Towers in Sarojini Nagar sees  ₹5,191-crore sale of 8.8 lakh sq ft apartments
items.p: State-owned NBCC has sold residential apartments spanning approximately 8.80 lakh sq ft at Avenue Towers on Africa Avenue Marg in New Delhi's Sarojini Nagar for around  ₹5,191 crore. The proceeds will be used to fund Central Government redevelopment projects.

items.h: UPI average daily transaction value crosses  ₹1 lakh crore for first time in October
items.p: UPI processed transactions worth an average of  ₹1,01,707 crore daily in October 2026, crossing the  ₹1 lakh crore mark for the first time. Monthly transaction value hit  ₹31.53 lakh crore, while transaction volume rose to 25.47 billion.

items.h: Creators and stand-up comics are driving India's live events boom
items.p: Creator-led formats and stand-up tours are expanding India's live entertainment market beyond music, though rising event costs and audience monetisation remain key hurdles.
